Jordan (CS): Hey team — FalconRetail just asked if we can run a customer-finetuned summarization model that needs PHI-aware redaction and a 150ms p95 token latency at 2k tps. They want it in their VPC so logs/data never leave their subnet. Can we do this in Private or Dedicated? What safety checks do we need before we let them go live?
Priya (Solutions): Short answer: yes, but we need a couple of clarifications first. Do they require on-prem (air-gapped) or VPC with KMS? Also need dataset size and whether the finetune included any third-party data.
Jordan (CS): They prefer VPC with customer-managed KMS. Finetune was ~25k annotated docs, mostly invoices and customer messages (some PHI). No 3rd-party licensed corpora.
Liam (ML Eng): Ok. For PHI redaction we should add an inference-time postprocessor + a safety eval. Recommend running our PHI-detection eval suite and the hallucination/regression prompt-set. Quantization/ops note: 13B fp16 in Dedicated or Private should hit latency with batching but 2k tps is high — might need autoscaling pool of A100s or a Triton-backed serving backend.
Liam (ML Eng): Example model config we can test:```json
{
  "model_name": "falcon-retail-13b-finetuned",
  "dtype": "fp16",
  "batching": {"max_batch_tokens": 2048, "microbatch": 8},
  "kv_cache_shards": 2,
  "postprocessors": ["phi-redaction-v2", "date-normalizer"]
}```
Ava (Security): KMS ok. Need to confirm: no model weights or logs stored in our hosted control plane for this Private deployment? Also we need the retention window for request logs and whether they want request-level audit logs (lawyers often ask). We'll require a DPA + SOC2 addendum for PHI.
Priya (Solutions): FalconRetail said they want minimal telemetry retention (7 days) and request-level audit only stored in their S3 (we can forward to their endpoint). They'll sign DPA but asked about timeline — target launch in 4 weeks to coincide with a product release.
Liam (ML Eng): 4 weeks is tight but doable if we parallelize: infra provisioning (VPC peering, KMS) + safety/regression evals + performance tuning. I can run an initial PHI-eval pass and a 10k prompt regression set within 5 business days.
Jordan (CS): Can you also run a quality gate that flags >1% hallucination increase vs baseline? They want rollback to a prior checkpoint if quality drops.
Liam (ML Eng): Yes — we can instrument the rollout with canary traffic at 5% then 25 then 100, and automatic quality checks. We'll use the eval thresholds: hallucination_delta <= 1%, rouge/bertscore within configured bounds.
Ava (Security): Also add HSM integration for key usage logs. I'll draft the compliance checklist and the extra addendum language.
deploy-bot: Ticket created — CS-4721: FalconRetail VPC private deployment, link: https://redwood/ops/CS-4721
Jordan (CS): Capturing customer feedback: they noted that latency SLO is non-negotiable and they want clear rollback runbooks. Also they want a short enablement session for their SREs — 60m deep-dive on the runtime config + how to read audit logs.
Priya (Solutions): I'll schedule the enablement session for next Wednesday 10am PT and add pre-req docs to their workspace.
Liam (ML Eng): Action items: 1) Run PHI-eval + regression (5bd). 2) Perf run w/ Dedicated A100s (3bd). 3) Canary rollout plan + rollback automation (2bd). I'll post perf logs to the ticket.
Ava (Security): I'll add required DPA clauses and retention settings to the ticket.
Jordan (CS): Heads-up on renewal risk — they're currently on a 1yr ent. contract that renews in 6 months. If we miss the 4-week target or if early quality is poor, this increases churn risk. Let's prioritize.
Priya (Solutions): Noted. I'll loop in AE and Solutions lead on the renewal healthcheck.
Jordan (CS): Thanks. I'll update FalconRetail with the plan and the ticket link. Please ping here if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
